label: Regular Collar 22
description: The Regular collar is the workhorse of dress shirt tailoring — a moderately spread, versatile collar that works equally well open-necked or with any standard tie knot. At 22mm of collar stand height, it sits comfortably above the jacket lapel without overwhelming the neckline. Its balanced proportions make it the default choice for business and formal occasions, projecting a clean, unfussy sophistication.
